The proposal role cannot submit or check D. Do not supply a device assignment as the method, edit the task/evaluator, or declare acceptance. Before proposing a method, distinguish a device edit D from a procedural H edit and identify which observations, controller decisions and complete responses depend on the changed inputs. Trace each event from its source through capture, any reset, and delivery; separate service completion from a claim about pending-state retention. Build source-bound energy and timing constraints without treating a sufficient design heuristic as a necessary feasible-space exclusion. State the proposed procedural change, its falsifier and the evidence that would invalidate its scope. A global H update must be consumed from task entry, and coupled D changes require complete feedback. Preserve counterexamples and UNKNOWN; return no-update if unsupported. Derive every task-specific value from the same sources available to the other conditions.
